Symbol: JSWDULUX 
 
Dear Sir/Madam, 
 
Sub: Outcome of Group Investor Call and Link of Audio Recording 
With reference to regulation 30 and other applicable provisions of SEBI (Listing Obligations and 
Disclosure Requirements), Regulations, 2015, we hereby inform that a group conference call 
was held today, 12th August 2026 at 15:00 hrs.  
 
The call was addressed by our senior management. The objective of the call was to discuss the 
financial results of the Company for the quarter ended 30th June 2026 and address queries.  
 
A presentation to the investors had already been shared to the Stock Exchanges and also 
uploaded on the website of the Company prior to the aforesaid call.  
 
Audio recording of the call is available on the Company website and can be accessed through 
following link: 
https://www.jswdulux.com/investors.php#im 
 
Further, please note the transcript of this call will be shared with the Stock Exchanges and will 
also be posted on the Company website within the stipulated timeline 
 
You are requested to kindly take the above information on record. 
 
Thanking you, 
 
Yours truly, 
For JSW Dulux Limited 
(Formerly Akzo Nobel India Limited) 
 
 
 
Rajiv L. Jha  
General Counsel & Company Secretary  
 
 
Rajiv 
Lochan 
Jha
Digitally signed
